description: This file contains unit tests for the MongoSearchUpdaterFlow class, specifically testing its restartability after certain MongoDB exceptions, and uses the Akka Streams testing framework.

classes.name: MongoSearchUpdaterFlowTest
classes.description: Test class for MongoSearchUpdaterFlow, contains setup, teardown, and test methods.

methods.name: startActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the Akka Actor System before tests.

methods.name: shutdownActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the Actor System after tests.

methods.name: streamIsRestartableAfterMongoBulkWriteException
methods.description: Tests that the flow restarts after a MongoBulkWriteException.

methods.name: streamIsRestartableAfterGenericMongoException

methods.name: testStreamRestart
